# Triple Seven Casino Slot Machine

Source UUID: 33cfdb5e-48c9-567e-8e60-d450f8de2439
Source path: pictographic-primitives/entertainment/casino 777 slot machine_33cfdb5e-48c9-567e-8e60-d450f8de2439.svg
Family: solo. Preserve the complete subject classification; do not split or reclassify.
Tags: triple, seven, casino, slot, machine.


Queue offset 30 review, 2026-09-22:
Inspected source: a slot machine with three adjacent reels containing the exact string "777", a base, and a right-hand lever with a round knob. Reuse preferred glyph digit-7 three times from icon_set/typeface/glyphs.json; do not redraw digits. The current glyph is fixed at 10 by 24 ink units; size exporter supports only height 24. Three glyphs with two required 4-unit gaps occupy 38 units of ink width. Even without reel dividers, two enclosing walls and their 4-unit interior gaps require at least 54 units overall, exceeding the widest SOLO48 rectangular envelope (44). A tilted whole layout does not repair this wide, tall assembly. Reducing to one seven, deleting digits or replacing the machine with a blank wrapper would change the subject. No compliant complete drawing or export is claimed; preserve solo classification and leave generation unresolved.
